summary: Multi-start SLSQP on (x, y, r) with analytic Jacobians, then basin-hopping perturbations of the best solution. Final radii are re-solved by an LP for the fixed centres and shrunk slightly so the result is strictly feasible.

Multi-start SLSQP on (x, y, r) with analytic Jacobians, starting from random points and from perturbed copies of the best solution (basin hopping). The final radii for the best centres come from an LP, with a tiny safety margin so nothing overlaps.
